Title: Sign in with email
User Story: As a member, I want to sign in with my email, so that I can reach my account.
User Acceptance Criteria: AC1: Given a registered member, when they sign in with the right password, then they see their dashboard.

Title: Reset a password
User Story: As a member, I want to reset my password, so that I can regain access.
User Acceptance Criteria: AC1: Given a registered member, when they ask for a reset, then they are sent a reset link.

Title: Export a list as CSV
User Story: As an analyst, I want to export a list as CSV, so that I can open it in a spreadsheet.
User Acceptance Criteria: AC1: Given a list with rows, when the analyst exports it, then a CSV file holds every row.

Title: Filter an export by date
User Story: As an analyst, I want to filter an export by date, so that I get only the rows I need.
User Acceptance Criteria: AC1: Given a list with rows from two months, when the analyst filters one month, then only that month's rows are exported.

Title: View monthly revenue
User Story: As a finance lead, I want to view revenue by month, so that I can spot a drop early.
User Acceptance Criteria: AC1: Given a year of orders, when the lead opens the view, then one total per month is shown.
